excluded_publication_objects.reason: PostgreSQL logical replication publications include base tables, not views; the view is restored/validated through schema and parity checks.

live_blockers: production-backend protected environment approval is required for live setup
staging setup must pass with direct Supabase DB URLs before production setup

refresh_policy.when_publication_tables_change: run ALTER SUBSCRIPTION refresh publication on the backend target after protected approval

replica_identity.validation_query: select n.nspname || '.' || c.relname as table_name from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where c.relkind = 'r' and n.nspname = 'public' and not exists (select 1 from pg_index i where i.indrelid = c.oid and (i.indisprimary or i.indisreplident))

rollback: drop Supabase replication slot after confirming no subscriber needs it
drop Supabase publication only after production cutover path no longer depends on it
remove migration-only replication credentials after rehearsal or retirement
